mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) at the decision date directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (as of decision date) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and a rise in residential sales and finance (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars signals an economic imbalance that triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO < 100 AND RSAFS > 450000) occurs in more than 30% of periods without negative 20-day returns over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 2.5%), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25 percentage points per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5%, FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential sales and finance (RSAFS) at the decision date indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS level is above 400,000 million dollars but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 for two consecutive months signals a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.5 for 2 consecutive months but SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% and a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 signals stagflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% AND INDPRO < 100.5) occurs in more than 30% of periods without negative 20-day returns over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand persons signals a labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, PAYEMS < 130000, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
